mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) and volume depletion may potentiate atomoxetine's cardiovascular effects and increase risk of arrhythmias; atomoxetine's noradrenergic activity combined with loop diuretic use increases sympathomimetic effects on heart rate and blood pressure.
action: Monitor electrolytes, blood pressure, and heart rate regularly; ensure adequate potassium supplementation; consider alternative diuretics or dose adjustments if significant electrolyte imbalances develop.
